# frozen_string_literal: true

# Profiling helper for RSpec runs. NOT loaded by default; opt in with:
#
#   PROF_OUT=tmp/perf/stack.dump bundle exec rspec spec/models \
#     --require ./docs/test-performance/tools/prof_helper.rb
#
# Produces:
#   * a StackProf wall-mode dump (analyse with stack_excl.rb / stack_self.rb)
#   * a stats file (<dump>.stats.txt) with SQL counts/time per statement kind and
#     the RSA(2048) keygen count/time.
#
# Overhead: StackProf adds ~10-20% wall time; compare relative shares, not absolutes.

require 'stackprof'
require 'openssl'

$perf = { sql_count: Hash.new(0), sql_time: Hash.new(0.0), rsa_count: 0, rsa_time: 0.0 }

module RSAProf
  def new(*args, **kw, &blk)
    return super unless args == [2048] && kw.empty?

    t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
    r = super
    $perf[:rsa_time] += Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - t
    $perf[:rsa_count] += 1
    r
  end
end
OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.singleton_class.prepend(RSAProf)

RSpec.configure do |c|
  c.before(:suite) do
    StackProf.start(mode: :wall, interval: 500, raw: true)
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('sql.active_record') do |*args|
      ev = ActiveSupport::Notifications::Event.new(*args)
      next if ev.payload[:cached] || ev.payload[:name] == 'SCHEMA'

      kind = ev.payload[:sql].to_s.split.first.to_s.upcase
      kind = ev.payload[:name] if ev.payload[:name].to_s.match?(/TRANSACTION|SAVEPOINT|RELEASE/i)
      $perf[:sql_count][kind] += 1
      # ActiveSupport event durations are already in milliseconds.
      $perf[:sql_time][kind] += ev.duration
    end
  end

  c.after(:suite) do
    StackProf.stop
    out = ENV.fetch('PROF_OUT', 'tmp/perf/stack.dump')
    StackProf.results(out)
    File.write(
      "#{out}.stats.txt",
      [
        "SQL count by kind: #{$perf[:sql_count].sort_by { -_2 }.first(25).inspect}",
        "SQL time (ms) by kind: #{$perf[:sql_time].transform_values { _1.round(1) }.sort_by { -_2 }.first(25).inspect}",
        "total SQL time (ms): #{$perf[:sql_time].values.sum.round(1)}  total SQL count: #{$perf[:sql_count].values.sum}",
        "RSA(2048) keygen count: #{$perf[:rsa_count]}  total time: #{$perf[:rsa_time].round(2)}s",
      ].join("\n") + "\n"
    )
  end
end

# SQL source profiler (NOT loaded by default). Groups executed SQL by spec file,
# by normalised statement, by first app call site and by example.
#
#   bundle exec rspec spec/models --require ./docs/test-performance/tools/sql_helper.rb
#   -> writes tmp/perf/sql_profile.txt
#
# Note: this adds overhead (caller_locations per query); use it for counts, not timings.

$sqlp = { by_file: Hash.new(0), by_stmt: Hash.new(0), by_site: Hash.new(0), by_example: Hash.new(0), total: 0 }

RSpec.configure do |c|
  c.before(:suite) do
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('sql.active_record') do |*args|
      ev = ActiveSupport::Notifications::Event.new(*args)
      p = ev.payload
      next if p[:cached] || p[:name] == 'SCHEMA'

      $sqlp[:total] += 1
      ex = RSpec.current_example
      $sqlp[:by_file][ex ? ex.metadata[:file_path] : '(no example)'] += 1
      $sqlp[:by_example][ex ? ex.full_description[0, 140] : '(none)'] += 1
      norm = p[:sql].to_s.gsub(/\$\d+/, '?').gsub(/\b\d+\b/, 'N').gsub(/'[^']*'/, "'S'").gsub(/\s+/, ' ')[0, 220]

# frozen_string_literal: true

# Exclusive (leaf-first) attribution of a StackProf raw dump to cost categories.
#
#   bundle exec ruby docs/test-performance/tools/stack_excl.rb tmp/perf/stack.dump
#
# IMPORTANT: StackProf raw stacks are stored ROOT-FIRST, so the leaf is `stack.last`.
# Each sample is assigned to the innermost frame that matches a category; app code is
# recognised by the /app/ path prefix (gem paths also contain "lib/", so don't match that).

require 'stackprof'

data = Marshal.load(File.binread(ARGV[0]))
frames = data[:frames]
raw = data[:raw]

CATEGORIES = [
  ['SQL log formatting (AR LogSubscriber + BacktraceCleaner)', /LogSubscriber|BacktraceCleaner|each_caller_location|Backtrace::Location/],
  ['DB I/O (PG::Connection)', /PG::Connection/],

$hook_timing_by_file = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = { before: 0.0, after: 0.0, total: 0.0, examples: 0 } }

module HookTimingExample
  def run_before_example
    t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
    super
  ensure
    $hook_timing_before_t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - t
  end

  def run_after_example
    t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
    super
  ensure

  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

# Splits total example time into: `before` hooks (config-level and group-level
# before/let!/setup), the example body (incl. the request and expectations) and
# `after` hooks. Also reports the time spent inside integration requests (any phase).
# Per-file and per-directory breakdowns are written to tmp/perf/hook_timing.txt.
# NOT loaded by default; opt in with:
#
#   bundle exec rspec spec/requests --require ./docs/test-performance/tools/hook_timing.rb
#
# Overhead: a few clock reads per example and per request (negligible).

EMPTY_ACC = { before: 0.0, after: 0.0, total: 0.0, requests: 0.0, examples: 0 }.freeze

$hook_timing = EMPTY_ACC.dup
$hook_timing_by_file = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = EMPTY_ACC.dup }

module HookTimingExample
  def run_before_example
    t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
    super
  ensure
    $hook_timing_before_t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - t
  end

  def run_after_example
    t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
    super
  ensure
    $hook_timing_after_t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - t
  end
end

RSpec::Core::Example.prepend(HookTimingExample)

# Time spent inside integration requests (get/post/... -> Session#process).
module HookTimingRequest
  def process(*, **)
    t = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
    super
  ensure
    $hook_timing_request_t = $hook_timing_request_t.to_f + (Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - t)
  end
end

ActionDispatch::Integration::Session.prepend(HookTimingRequest)

RSpec.configure do |c|
  c.around do |example|
    start = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
    $hook_timing_request_t = 0.0
    example.run
  ensure
    total = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - start
    file = example.metadata[:file_path].to_s.sub('./', '')
    sample = { total:, before: $hook_timing_before_t.to_f, after: $hook_timing_after_t.to_f, requests: $hook_timing_request_t.to_f }
    [$hook_timing, $hook_timing_by_file[file]].each do |acc|
      acc[:total] += sample[:total]
      acc[:before] += sample[:before]
      acc[:after] += sample[:after]
      acc[:requests] += sample[:requests]
      acc[:examples] += 1
    end
    $hook_timing_before_t = $hook_timing_after_t = nil
  end

  c.after(:suite) do
    fmt = lambda do |label, h|
      body = h[:total] - h[:before] - h[:after]
      pct = ->(v) { v * 100 / [h[:total], 1e-9].max }
      format(
        '%-30s ex=%5d total=%8.1fs before=%8.1fs(%4.1f%%) body=%8.1fs(%4.1f%%) after=%6.1fs(%4.1f%%) requests(any phase)=%8.1fs(%4.1f%%)',
        label, h[:examples], h[:total], h[:before], pct.call(h[:before]), body, pct.call(body), h[:after], pct.call(h[:after]),
        h[:requests], pct.call(h[:requests])
      )
    end

    lines = ['== overall', fmt.call('all examples', $hook_timing), '', '== by file (top 40 by total)']
    $hook_timing_by_file.sort_by { -_2[:total] }.first(40).each { |f, h| lines << fmt.call(f, h) }

    by_dir = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = EMPTY_ACC.dup }
    $hook_timing_by_file.each do |f, h|
      d = f.split('/')[0, 3].join('/')

    end
    lines += ['', '== by dir (depth 3, top 30)']
    by_dir.sort_by { -_2[:total] }.first(30).each { |d, h| lines << fmt.call(d, h) }

    FileUtils.mkdir_p('tmp/perf')
    File.write('tmp/perf/hook_timing.txt', "#{lines.join("\n")}\n")
    puts lines.first(2)
  end
end
